properties.doc: Specifies how the bubble size values are represented on the bubble chart. This is the property not only of this series but of all series of parent series group - this is projection of appropriate group property. And so this property is read-only. Use ParentSeriesGroup property for access to parent series group. Use ParentSeriesGroup.BubbleSizeRepresentation read/write property for change value.
properties.name: bubble_size_representation

properties.doc: Specifies the scale factor for the bubble chart (can be between 0 and 300 percents of the default size). This is the property not only of this series but of all series of parent series group - this is projection of appropriate group property. And so this property is read-only. Use ParentSeriesGroup property for access to parent series group. Use ParentSeriesGroup.BubbleSizeScale read/write property for change value.
properties.name: bubble_size_scale

properties.doc: Returns collection of data points of this series. Read-only .
properties.name: data_points

properties.doc: Specifies the size of the hole in a doughnut chart (can be between 10 and 90 percents of the size of the plot area.). This is the property not only of this series but of all series of parent series group - this is projection of appropriate group property. And so this property is read-only. Use ParentSeriesGroup property for access to parent series group. Use ParentSeriesGroup.DoughnutHoleSize read/write property for change value. Read-only .
properties.name: doughnut_hole_size

properties.doc: Represents ErrorBars of series with derection X. ErrorBars with X direction are avalible for series of type area, bar, scatter and bubble. For any other types of chart this property returns null (including 3D charts). In case of custom values use DataPoints collection to specify value (with property). Read-only .
properties.name: error_bars_x_format

properties.doc: Represents ErrorBars of series with derection Y. ErrorBars with Y direction are avalible for series of type area, bar, line, scatter and bubble. For any other types of chart this property returns null (including 3D charts). In case of custom values use DataPoints collection to specify value (with property). Read-only .
properties.name: error_bars_y_format

properties.doc: Specifies the angle of the first pie or doughnut chart slice, in degrees (clockwise from up, from 0 to 360 degrees). This is the property not only of this series but of all series of parent series group - this is projection of appropriate group property. And so this property is read-only. Use ParentSeriesGroup property for access to parent series group. Use ParentSeriesGroup.FirstSliceAngle read/write property for change value. Read-only .
properties.name: first_slice_angle

properties.doc: Returns or sets the distance, as a percentage of the marker width, between the data series in a 3D chart. This is the property not only of this series but of all series of parent series group - this is projection of appropriate group property. And so this property is read-only. Use ParentSeriesGroup property for access to parent series group. Use ParentSeriesGroup.GapDepth read/write property for change value. Read-only .
properties.name: gap_depth

properties.doc: Specifies the space between bar or column clusters, as a percentage of the bar or column width. This is the property not only of this series but of all series of parent series group - this is projection of appropriate group property. And so this property is read-only. Use ParentSeriesGroup property for access to parent series group. Use ParentSeriesGroup.GapWidth read/write property for change value. Read-only .
properties.name: gap_width

properties.doc: Determines whether there are series lines for this series and kindred series. This is the property not only of this series but of all series of parent series group - this is projection of appropriate group property. And so this property is read-only. Use ParentSeriesGroup property for access to parent series group. Use ParentSeriesGroup.HasSeriesLines read/write property for change value. Use ParentSeriesGroup.SeriesLinesFormat property for format series lines. Read-only .
properties.name: has_series_lines

properties.doc: Specifies that each data marker in the series has a different color. This is the property not only of this series but of all series of parent series group - this is projection of appropriate group property. And so this property is read-only. Use ParentSeriesGroup property for access to parent series group. Use ParentSeriesGroup.IsColorVaried read/write property for change value. Read-only .
properties.name: is_color_varied

properties.doc: Returns the Labels of a series. Read-only .
properties.name: labels

properties.doc: Return series marker. Read-only .
properties.name: marker

properties.doc: Return series name. Read-only .
properties.name: name

properties.doc: Returns the order of a series. Read/write .
properties.name: order

properties.doc: Specifies how much bars and columns overlap on 2-D charts, as a percentage (from -100% to 100%). This is the property not only of this series but of all series of parent series group. It is a projection of the appropriate property in the parent series group, and so this property is read-only. To change the value, use the ParentSeriesGroup.Overlap read/write property. Read-only .

properties.doc: Returns parent series group. Read-only .
properties.name: parent_series_group

properties.doc: Specifies how to determine which data points are in the second pie or bar on a pie-of-pie or bar-of-pie chart. Use ParentSeriesGroup property for access to parent series group. Use ParentSeriesGroup.PieSplitBy read/write property for change value. Read-only .

properties.doc: Specifies a value that shall be used to determine which data points are in the second pie or bar on a pie-of-pie or bar-of-pie chart. Is used together with PieSplitBy property. This is the property not only of this series but of all series of parent series group - this is projection of appropriate group property. And so this property is read-only. Use ParentSeriesGroup property for access to parent series group. Use ParentSeriesGroup.PieSplitPosition read/write property for change value. Read-only .
properties.name: pie_split_position

properties.doc: Indicates if this series is plotted on second value axis. Read/write .
properties.name: plot_on_second_axis

properties.doc: Specifies the size of the second pie or bar of a pie-of-pie chart or a bar-of-pie chart, as a percentage of the size of the first pie (can be between 5 and 200 percents). This is the property not only of this series but of all series of parent series group - this is projection of appropriate group property. And so this property is read-only. Use ParentSeriesGroup property for access to parent series group. Use ParentSeriesGroup.SecondPieSize read/write property for change value. Read-only .
